_source: Beta product video (beta.progbiz.io), Bordio-style 4-minute walkthrough. Every claim was checked against the live pages on 2026-09-29 (reports/video/beta/scout/). Draft wording — awaiting Vismaya's approval.

sections.title: Opening
sections.visual: Title card, then a quick montage of Home, AI Assistant, Dashboard, Kanban
sentences: Leads arrive from everywhere — Facebook ads, your website, WhatsApp and phone calls.
Keeping track of every one of them, and every follow-up, is where sales teams lose deals.
Meet ProgBiz ERP — one CRM that keeps your whole sales team on the same page.

sections.title: Home
sections.visual: Home: summary cards, Today's Schedule, Followup History, Summary
sentences: Every day starts on the Home screen.
New leads, follow-ups, delayed work and completed activities are visible at a glance.
Today’s schedule shows who to call and when, the follow-up history shows what your team just did, and the summary breaks your leads down by stage.
callouts: One place to start your day

sections.title: AI Assistant
sections.visual: AI Assistant: New chat, type 'How many leads today?', answer appears
sentences: Need an answer fast? Just ask.
The AI Assistant understands questions about your own business data.
Type a question like, how many leads today, and get the answer in seconds — no reports, no spreadsheets.
Ask about follow-ups due today, delayed tasks, project status, or even who is present today.
Previous conversations are saved on the left, so you can pick up where you left off.

sections.title: CRM Dashboard
sections.visual: CRM Dashboard: KPI rates, stage cards, Leads in Follow-up; scroll to Executive-Wise Leads, Call Activity, Lead Source ROI
sentences: For managers, the CRM Dashboard turns sales activity into a clear picture.
Win rate, conversion rate, lost rate and pipeline value sit right at the top, with every lead grouped by stage — new, cold, warm, hot, won and lost.
Leads in follow-up are split into today’s, delayed and upcoming, so priorities are obvious.
Change the period or pick one executive in a click, and download any table when you need it.
Scroll down to compare every executive side by side, follow call activity, and see which lead sources actually bring in revenue.

sections.title: Leads
sections.visual: Leads: Nature tabs, Status View tabs, filter panel; Bulk Lead Transfer filters
sentences: All your enquiries live in Leads.
Tabs keep new, in follow-up, won and lost leads apart, and Status View breaks them down by every stage of your sales process.
Every lead shows its source, value, date and assigned executive in one row.
Powerful filters find any lead by source, quality, assignee, date, or even Facebook campaign.
And when priorities change, Lead Transfer moves leads between executives in bulk.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.visual: Follow-ups: Today's / Delayed / Upcoming / Non Followup tabs, then Kanban View
sentences: A lead is only as valuable as its next action.
Follow-ups are sorted into today’s, delayed, upcoming and non follow-up, so nothing slips through the cracks.
Prefer a board? Kanban View shows every follow-up by status, with the next date, last contact and executive on each card.
So your team always knows exactly who to call next.

sections.title: AI Call Analysis
sections.visual: AI Call Analysis list (Lead / Agent score, Sentiment), then the Call Analysis detail: scores, Summary, Coaching Note
sentences: This is where ProgBiz goes further.
AI Call Analysis reviews your team’s recorded calls.
Managers can listen to any recording right from the list.
Every call gets a lead score, an agent score and the customer’s sentiment.
Open a call to read an AI summary of the conversation and a coaching note for your executive — so you know which calls went well, and how to close the next one.

sections.title: Executive Performance
sections.visual: Executive Performance: KPI cards, top-3 ranking, score formula, executives table with AI Score
sentences: Executive Performance brings it all together.
Each executive gets one score, built from target achievement, win rate, won value and activity — with leads, follow-ups, calls and AI scores in a single table.
Your best performers rise to the top, and everyone can see where to improve.

sections.title: Closing
sentences: Capture every lead, never miss a follow-up, and know exactly how your team is performing.
ProgBiz ERP — bringing your business workflow together.
sections.end_card_cta: Capture every lead. Never miss a follow-up. Know how your team performs.
